english: I looked out of the window.
text: 中文说“向窗外望去”，英语常用 look out of the window，口语里也常说 look out the window，两种都自然。要表达往某个封闭空间外面看，可以用 look out of + 具体地方，比如 look out of the door。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
